title: The LORD Challenges Job

questions.question: Shall a faultfinder contend with the what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:2 (ESV): "Shall a faultfinder contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it."

questions.question: What does Job answer the Lord?
options: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
questions.correctAnswer: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
questions.explanation: Job 40:4 (ESV): "Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth."

questions.question: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; twice, but I will proceed no what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:5 (ESV): "I have spoken once, and I will not answer; twice, but I will proceed no further."

questions.question: Dress for action like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to whom?
questions.explanation: Job 40:7 (ESV): "Dress for action like a man; I will question you, and you make it known to me."

questions.question: Behold, Behemoth, which I made as I made whom?
questions.explanation: Job 40:15 (ESV): "Behold, Behemoth, which I made as I made you; he eats grass like an ox."

questions.question: Will you even put me in the wrong? Will you condemn me that you may be in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:8 (ESV): "Will you even put me in the wrong? Will you condemn me that you may be in the right?"

questions.question: Have you an arm like God, and can you thunder with a voice like what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:9 (ESV): "Have you an arm like God, and can you thunder with a voice like his?"

questions.question: Adorn yourself with majesty and dignity; clothe yourself with glory and what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:10 (ESV): "Adorn yourself with majesty and dignity; clothe yourself with glory and splendor."

questions.question: Look on everyone who is proud and bring him what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:12 (ESV): "Look on everyone who is proud and bring him low and tread down the wicked where they stand."

questions.question: He eats grass like an what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:15 (ESV): "...he eats grass like an ox."

questions.question: Behold, his strength in his loins, and his power in the muscles of his what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:16 (ESV): "Behold, his strength in his loins, and his power in the muscles of his belly."

questions.question: He makes his tail stiff like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:17 (ESV): "He makes his tail stiff like a cedar; the sinews of his thighs are knit together."

questions.question: His bones are tubes of bronze, his limbs like bars of what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:18 (ESV): "His bones are tubes of bronze, his limbs like bars of iron."

questions.question: He is the first of the works of God; let him who made him bring near his what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:19 (ESV): "He is the first of the works of God; let him who made him bring near his sword."

questions.question: Under the lotus plants he lies, in the shelter of the reeds and in the what?
questions.explanation: Job 40:21 (ESV): "Under the lotus plants he lies, in the shelter of the reeds and in the marsh."

key_verse_text: Behold, I am of small account; what shall I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
